verdict_reason: Doc-only addition that accurately describes the new results route, with one Minor note that it omits the route's write of stored search rows.

todos.issue: The new sentence says the results route 'saves no lines', which reads as 'writes nothing', but postResults runs showSelectionWork -> searchAndStoreRows (search.controller.js:105-119), which calls replaceStoredSearchRows and so rewrites the stored search rows in session state on every keystroke-driven POST. It is true that no commodityLines are saved, but the doc hides a state write a maintainer needs to know about (a later Continue only accepts keys present in those stored rows, per readPost/knownRowsByKey).
todos.fix: Must: the doc line states what the results route writes as well as what it does not: it records the matched search rows so a later submit can accept them, and saves no commodity lines. One way: 'Its results route renders only the results, for the page's multi-select search to swap in. It records the rows it found, so a later Continue can accept them, and saves no commodity lines.'
